content.thinking: Right — I created a call cycle a↔b, which violates "All call and pipe dependency edges together form a DAG". Let me remove the cycle (use one-way calls).

arguments.command:
cd /workspace/tmp && python3 - <<'EOF'
s=open('t_i.py').read()
s=s.replace('"calls": [["a", "b"], ["b", "a"]],', '"calls": [["a", "b"]],')
open('t_i.py','w').write(s)
EOF
python3 t_i.py > tests/i.input.json && python3 /workspace/project/campaign_cli.py < tests/i.input.json | python3 -c "
import json,sys
d=json.load(sys.stdin)
for p in d['plans']: print(p['entry'], p['modules'], p['types'], p['slots'], p['flag'], p['variables'])
print([r['status'] for r in d['records']])
for c in d['corpus']: print(c)"
